Class RenderGalleryChecks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.RenderGalleryChecks
public final class RenderGalleryChecks extends Object
The render-gallery world builder: that a queued gallery lays out its floor and rows as described and reports the totals it finished with, spread across ticks by the configured placement limit.

  • Method Details

    • queuedStorageGalleryBuildsFloorRowsAndCompletionTotals

      public static void queuedStorageGalleryBuildsFloorRowsAndCompletionTotals(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      A queued Storage gallery builds its sandstone floor, one column per item group, and reports planned and completed totals. To reproduce in-game: enable galleries and run an /ss gallery form containing multiple groups. The rows begin east of the player on a sandstone floor and the completion message reports the placed stacks and items.

    • queuedStorageGallerySpreadsWorkAcrossTicks

      public static void queuedStorageGallerySpreadsWorkAcrossTicks(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      Gallery placement obeys the configured per-tick budget. To reproduce in-game: lower render_gallery.placements_per_tick and request a large Storage gallery. Construction visibly progresses across multiple ticks rather than completing in one server tick.

    • queuedBarGalleryBuildsRowsAndFillsBars

      public static void queuedBarGalleryBuildsRowsAndFillsBars(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      A Bar gallery lays out rows and fills each block up to its capacity before starting the next. To reproduce in-game: enable galleries and run /ss ingotgallery for more than one block's worth of one ingot. The first row is full and the next holds the remainder.
